messages:
maria_cs: Hey team — Helios Systems (acct helios-prod) reached out. Sales applied a contract promo (code RED-ENT-100K) and submitted a PO but the credit is not showing on their invoice. PO #8742 attached by customer. Can someone confirm if the manual credit was processed?

tony_sales: I recorded the promo in our CRM and included the PO note: "Apply RED-ENT-100K per SOW; net 0 for first 3 months". Sent finance the PO yesterday afternoon. I thought ops would create the manual adjustment.

jenna_billing: I can't find a matching ledger entry. Searching by PO and promo code returns nothing. Customer invoice #45821 still shows full balance. Did finance post a journal entry or was this done via the billing console?

elena_finance: Not in the general ledger yet. We received the PO as an email, but the note was ambiguous — the PO text had the promo code in the footer image and our parser probably missed it. I put this on hold pending confirmation.

kai_support: Customer tried self-serve credit application via our admin API and hit an auth error. They sent this log: 
```
POST /v1/admin/credits
403 Forbidden
{ "error": "insufficient_scope", "message": "token missing billing:write" }
```
Customer said they used the sales token that Tony shared. Sales tokens can't write to billing.

maria_cs: Confirming — Helios forwarded the screenshot of the PO and a short note from procurement referencing the contract. They expected the credit to be reflected on next invoice. They're getting anxious. Can we do a manual grant and attach an audit note that references the PO and the sales contact?

ton y_sales: @maria_cs tagging correct handle: tony_sales — yes, please include my CRM record id: CRM-55213. 

jenna_billing: Steps I'll take: 1) Create manual credit in billing UI with source=\"sales_manual\" 2) Link to invoice #45821 3) Post journal entry with memo referencing PO 8742 and CRM-55213. Need GL code and approval from Finance.

elena_finance: Approve for manual credit up to $100,000. Use GL code 4850 and set internal_ref LGR-2026-378. Please include the PO image as attachment.

kai_support: I can provision a temporary billing token for Tony with `billing:write` scope so sales can test the API path without using their personal token. But we should not do that for production.

maria_cs: Please do manual grant now if you have approval — customer wants acknowledgement before EOD PST. Also add an audit note that the PO had an embedded promo image that our parser missed.

jenna_billing: Starting manual grant. Quick question: do we credit the invoice by line (embedding credits) or issue an account-level credit memo? Customer wants the invoice adjusted.

elena_finance: Adjust the invoice line so downstream collections sees zero balance for that invoice; create account-level memo as fallback. Both should reference PO 8742.

billing-bot: Manual credit ticket created: MG-4021. Assigned to jenna_billing. Estimated completion 45m.

kai_support: For the API error, reproduced locally: sales token lacks `billing:write`. If we want to allow sales to trigger test credits in sandbox, add role `sandbox-billing-writer` with limited scope. I'll open infra ticket for sandbox role.

tony_sales: I can resend the original PO as a PDF to finance@redwood and add a signed note from procurement. Apologies for the image-only PO — my fault.

maria_cs: Customer updated — they uploaded the PDF to the support thread and asked for a confirmation email once it's processed.

jenna_billing: Done — created manual credit, linked to invoice #45821, journal posted (ref LGR-2026-378), memo: "Sales manual credit per PO 8742, CRM-55213, code RED-ENT-100K". Attached the PDF. Balance now shows $0. Sent confirmation email to customer and CC'd Tony.

elena_finance: Verified journal and attachment. Marking MG-4021 as complete from finance side. I'll add a one-line note for month-end audit.

maria_cs: Customer replied: "Thanks — confirmed invoice updated and ledger note received. Appreciate the quick help." :white_check_mark:

kai_support: Filed infra ticket INF-1187 to add `sandbox-billing-writer` role and improve PO parser for inline images.

tony_sales: Awesome. Two follow-ups: 1) I'll request sales to include PO as PDF going forward. 2) Can we get a short internal playbook for handling image-only POs?

maria_cs: I'll draft a one-pager in the CS playbook repo and link it here when ready. Closing this thread once playbook is up.

billing-bot: MG-4021 closed by jenna_billing at 1769127189.
